content.name: Gabriel Tremblay
content.title: Data Analyst II
content.summary: Bilingual data analyst with eight years in energy services, credit union banking and public transit. Currently own ridership and service reliability reporting for a regional transit authority, where my route-level analysis informed a schedule redesign affecting 40,000 weekday riders. Strong in SQL, Tableau and turning analysis into plain-language briefings in English or French.

experience.title: Data Analyst II
bullets: Own ridership, on-time performance and fare revenue reporting for 62 bus routes, publishing a monthly Tableau scorecard for the executive team and council liaison.
Combined automatic passenger counter data with farebox records to model route-level crowding, shaping a schedule redesign for roughly 40,000 weekday riders.
Cut the quarterly service review prep time from three weeks to six days by moving source extracts into scheduled SQL views.
Mentor a co-op student each term and wrote the team's onboarding guide for the data warehouse.

experience.title: Data Analyst
bullets: Built member attrition reports that segmented 85,000 accounts by product mix, helping the retention team target outreach and lower annual attrition from 9.4% to 7.9%.
Delivered monthly regulatory and board reporting on loan delinquency with zero restatements over 33 months.
Partnered with marketing on a GIC renewal campaign test; the winning offer letter improved renewals by 6 points.

experience.title: Junior Analyst
bullets: Consolidated field ticket data from 14 crews into a single Access-to-SQL Server database, ending weekly copy-and-paste reconciliations.
Tracked equipment utilization across 300 rental assets and flagged idle units that were later redeployed, avoiding about $220,000 in new purchases.
Prepared invoice accuracy reports that reduced customer billing disputes by 15% over one year.

education.degree: DEC in Natural Sciences (Sciences de la nature)

achievements.title: Open data contribution
achievements.detail: Published a cleaned, documented ridership dataset on the authority's open data portal, now downloaded by local researchers.

achievements.title: Employee recognition award
achievements.detail: Recognized by Chinook Prairie Credit Union leadership in 2022 for the attrition segmentation work.
